description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p16-universal-autoload.pl.

ROW BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 1 row):
  method.t 99 `check if UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD works`
  -- perl-tests/method.t:393-401, a `fresh_perl_is` run three times over
     `['Bar','Foo::Bar'], ['SUPER::Bar','main::SUPER::Bar'],
      ['Xyz::SUPER::Bar','Xyz::SUPER::Bar']`

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl) -- the fresh_perl child's own program:
    package UNIVERSAL; sub AUTOLOAD { my $c = shift; print "$c $AUTOLOAD\n" }
    sub DESTROY {}
    package Xyz;
    package main; Foo->Bar();
    package main; Foo->SUPER::Bar();
    package main; Foo->Xyz::SUPER::Bar();
  perl: Foo Foo::Bar
        Foo main::SUPER::Bar
        Foo Xyz::SUPER::Bar
  PCL : dies on the FIRST call --
        `Can't locate object method "Bar" via package "Foo"
         (perhaps you forgot to load "Foo"?)`

MECHANISM: perl's method resolution falls back to `UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD` when
no method and no per-class AUTOLOAD is found anywhere in the MRO.  PCL's
dispatcher raises "Can't locate object method" instead.  Note all THREE
shapes are behind the one row, including the fully-qualified
`Pkg::SUPER::method` name form, whose `$AUTOLOAD` must be the literal
`Xyz::SUPER::Bar`.  Fix area: the method-dispatch fallback in
`cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md method.t, "`UNIVERSAL::
AUTOLOAD` (tests 97-99): `$AUTOLOAD` scoping across packages" -- narrower
than the truth: the handler is not reached at all, so scoping never arises.

FAMILY: AUTOLOAD dispatch; sibling #1486 (the glob-install half), #468 (a
plain call to a never-declared sub reaching AUTOLOAD, CLOSED).
subject: BUG (method dispatch): `UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD` is never consulted -- with `package UNIVERSAL; sub AUTOLOAD {...}` in force, `Foo->Bar()` calls the handler in perl and dies "Can't locate object method" in PCL
